name: @agenticprimitives-demo/discovery-indexer
description: Discovery indexer (demo-discovery-indexer): enumerates every Smart Agent in agent-naming and projects available on-chain facets into the discovery A-box (GraphDB @ agentkg.io), then loads the agentic-trust ontology so the KB self-describes. Demo-grade reference; a production agent-indexer graduates to an external repo (ADR-0037) when packages publish.
